notes: The individual JSON files preserve all records from the Excel sheets.
The combined config.json is clipped to the configured route endpoint at km 1447 for compatibility with the supplied HWH-NDLS timetable.
Gaps in speed restrictions are preserved; the optimiser uses the train line-speed limit where no restriction is specified.
Gaps in curve records are preserved; the optimiser treats them as no curve (degree 0).
Gradient sign conversion assumes direction 1 means uphill/ascending, -1 means downhill/descending, and 0 means level, based on the source column heading.
